svg.title: British Columbia Ferry Commission — reconstructed vector logo
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the official 841 by 895 pixel BC Ferry Commission logo. Thirty individual outlined letters surround a coloured provincial shield. Original PDF vector curves are reused for sun rays, sun disc, and crown; colour fields, details, lettering, and perimeter are reconstructed from the official PNG. No raster images, live fonts, filters, or external dependencies.
svg.metadata: {"status": "Reconstructed logo, not a recovered official full-colour master", "reference": "https://www.bcferrycommission.ca/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/BCFC_full-colour_pos.png", "native_structural_source": "https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/british-columbians-our-governments/celebrating-british-columbia/symbols-of-bc/bc-emblems-set.pdf", "native_source_page": 3, "native_source_components": ["sun rays", "sun disc", "crown"], "canvas": [841, 895], "lettering": "BRITISH COLUMBIA / FERRY COMMISSION", "font_status": "Outlined from reference; no exact font identification claimed", "palette": "Published PNG sRGB values"}
